title: Dataplex: Data Product Insights & Critical Schema Immutability
summary: Dataplex now generates rich data product insights, including asset descriptions and sample queries. Be aware of critical breaking changes as several key documentation and entry properties are now read-only, requiring immediate code updates.
details: Several properties across `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResult`, `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResultDataProductResult`, `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResultDataProductResultAssetDescription`, and `GoogleCloudDataplexV1Entry` have been made read-only. Specifically, `dataProductResult` (in `DataDocumentationResult`), `assetDescriptions`, `overview`, `queries` (in `DataProductResult`), `overview`, `resource` (in `AssetDescription`), and `entryGroupType` (in `Entry`) are now immutable. Any applications attempting to write to these fields will now encounter errors and must be updated. The `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResult` schema now includes a new `dataProductResult` property, providing generated insights for data products. This includes `assetDescriptions` for individual assets, an `overview` for the entire product, and `queries` with sample SQL. These new fields offer a richer understanding of your data products. For batch metadata change requests, the `GoogleCloudDataplexV1RequestBatchMetadataChangeRequest` schema gains a new `deferredValidation` boolean field. This allows you to defer reference validation until the change request is approved, providing more flexibility in your metadata workflows. The `projects.locations.lookupEntryLinks` method has seen adjustments to its available scopes. While `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/dataplex.read-write` and `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/dataplex.readonly` have been explicitly added, one of the previously listed `dataplex.read-write` scopes has been replaced with `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform.read-only`. Review your application's scope usage for this method.
